state_switch_claim: The draft has a closed state, a vector-open state, a traversal state, and a patch-applied state. Opening the patch receipt proves route words mutate the selected surface.

closed_state.description: Selected path without appended shadow slices.
lines: P4 Pinhole logic keeps a borrowed zero.
A4 At sleep-depth, voltage braids the coil.
T4 Tiny motors listen before the button.
C4 Coded air subtracts the spare module.
H4 Hushed parity bites through the latch.
E4 Each vowel rents one foreign glyph.
D4 Darker syntax molts beside a spool.

open_state.description: Selected path after disclosure opens the apparatus; each selected line receives its selector-vector shadow slice.
